## About
Rader Collision Center started with Dan Rader's love for working on racecars and hot rods. It began as a hobby in his garage, and over time he turned that passion into a full time career.
Our goal is to restore every vehicle to pre-loss condition in a timely manner and at an affordable price. We work with all insurance companies and repair both foreign and domestic vehicles.
We use computerized equipment, certified technicians, factory-compatible paints and a written lifetime warranty on our work. We have also made changes to be more environmentally aware, including training our team in techniques to minimize waste.

## Services
- Computerized frame and unibody repairs: Frame and unibody straightening using computerized equipment.
- Computerized painting and color matching: Paint work matched to your vehicle's color.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents taken out without repainting.
- Mechanical and suspension repairs with alignment: Suspension and mechanical repairs, with alignment and adjustment printouts.
- Wheel refinishing and repair
- Glass replacement
- Leased car due to return to the dealership: Bring it to us first, and we will handle the repairs before the dealer charges you.
- Free towing: Free towing for the first 10 miles.
- Custom lettering and striping
- Fleet work: Call us for fleet pricing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all insurance companies, and we repair both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates done in our shop are free.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, and Saturdays are by appointment.

Q: Going on vacation?
A: No problem. We will drop you off at the airport, and in most cases your car will be ready when you get back.

I was driving to Mammoth Cave in Kentucky last month as part of my vacation from work when I missed one of my turns in the midst of my route. The only turnaround visible for the foreseeable future involved me crossing a set of railroad tracks. The road allowing me to cross the railroad tracks was very thin and blended into the gravel.  You can guess, I missed the road and wound up falling into a gravel ditch, hitting my front bumper on one of the tracks and killing one of the fog lights in the process. Me and my father were looking for auto body shops that worked with our insurance when we found Rader Collision Center. The day after the accident we took the car in for an estimate. The receptionist (I believe her name is Marty) was very welcoming and an absolute pleasure to work with while we awaited an estimate. The owner (Dan) was unavailable for estimates at the time (he was doing another one) so she offered to photograph the vehicle's damage so the technicians could determine the estimate. Once Dan became available he offered to zip tie my bumper on while we waited for the estimate to be finalized and repairs to begin. Three weeks later we took the car in. While they were painting the new bumper on the car they caught that the radiator support was almost snapped, saving us nearly grands in repairs for a fallen out radiator. Unfortunately the first time the part they got was broken so they had to reorder it. Apparently no dealership in town had the part so they have to order from a different source. Eventually they were able to get the part. So the repairs took a week and a half longer than expected, but I am very happy they caught that radiator support. When we picked up the car they personally thanked us for selecting them to repair my car in a very sincere manner. Since they were unable to get me out of a deductible due to their contract with my insurance, they instead gave me a 100 dollar gift card to Kroger which really helps a lot since I shop there for my food and other kitchen supplies. Really the most down to earth and nicest people I have ever met in my life. Five stars is not enough. I will definitely be bringing my cars back here from now on (hopefully not anytime soon, I don't want another accident). I will certainly be recommending to anyone that asks me. The pictures I have posted are the before and after images of my car. They didn't just fix my bumper, they waxed my car and buffed out scratches and also did a full detail of the interior."
